description: Fetches a public page (first 512 KB) and returns its link-preview metadata: title, description, image, Open Graph and Twitter tags, canonical URL, icons and missing tags. Returns { url, finalUrl, status, title, description, image, siteName, canonical, icons, lang, og, twitter, missing, truncated } Price: 3 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private, loopback, link-local, metadata and our own hosts are refused.
